title: Spectroscopic confirmation of neural-network lens candidates from DESI imaging
summary: A residual neural network selected strong gravitational lens candidates in the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys. VLT/MUSE spectroscopy of 76 candidates (223 spectra) confirmed 55 lenses with both lens and source redshifts, 15 with lens redshift only, and found 6 non-lenses. Caveat: the source is an arXiv preprint (submitted 22 September 2025) that does not name the network architecture or list institutions on its abstract page.
ai_technology: residual neural network (convolutional classifier for strong lens candidates)

evidence.tested: VLT/MUSE spectroscopy of 76 neural-network-selected candidates (223 spectra) confirmed 55 lenses with both redshifts, 15 with lens redshift only, and 6 non-lenses.
evidence.unknown: Redshifts were obtained by manual identification of spectral features, and background source redshifts could not be determined for 15 targets.
evidence.ai_role: A residual neural network selected strong lens candidates in the DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys; the architecture is not described on the page.
